# Shi/Hose 2009 curated CellML source

The fifteen `.cellml` files in this directory are unmodified source bytes from
the Physiome Model Repository workspace **Shi, Hose, 2009**, changeset
`a679cdc2e97429fb5280af8132c119758626c1f2`.

Authors credited in the source: **Yubing Shi and Rod Hose**. Model title:
*Zero dimensional (lumped parameter) modelling of native human cardiovascular
dynamics*. The selected exposure is titled **Korakianitis, Shi, 2006**; the
CellML documentation identifies the underlying published models and its valve
simplifications. This distribution preserves that documentation and authorship
metadata inside the original files.

- [Exact source workspace](https://models.physiomeproject.org/workspace/shi_hose_2009/@@file/a679cdc2e97429fb5280af8132c119758626c1f2/)
- [Curated exposure](https://models.physiomeproject.org/exposure/c49d416ae3a5132882e6ea7479ba50f5)
- [Exposure license and citation](https://models.physiomeproject.org/exposure/c49d416ae3a5132882e6ea7479ba50f5/ModelMain.cellml/license_citation)
- [Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)

These source files are licensed **CC BY 3.0**, separately from Numi's code.
No changes were made to their bytes. `source-lock.json` records every file
size, SHA-256 and immutable source URL, together with the retrieved archive
identity and license-page receipt. Numi's offline translation and numerical
settings are separate files outside this directory and must not be attributed
to the source authors. The source schematic remains available in the upstream
archive; the fifteen CellML runtime imports are all retained here.

Source identity and attribution are not numerical reproduction, independent
physiological validation, or subject calibration. The CellML simplification
uses instantaneous one-way orifice valves; preserving it does not reproduce
the original papers' dynamic valve-leaflet states.
